card.name: Dado Gracioso
card.summary: Seus monstros com a face para cima ganham ATK e DEF iguais a um único resultado de dado × 100 até o fim do turno.

textEvidence.text: Roll one fair six-sided die at resolution. All face-up monsters currently controlled by the activating player gain ATK and DEF equal to the single roll multiplied by 100 until the end of the current turn. Compute the current group once; a later summon gets no modifier. No target or cost. A negated activation does not roll. The stat change can resolve during the Damage Step before damage calculation.

card.name: Dado Caveira
card.summary: Os monstros adversários com a face para cima perdem ATK e DEF iguais a um único resultado de dado × 100 até o fim do turno.

textEvidence.text: Roll one fair six-sided die at resolution. All face-up monsters currently controlled by the opponent lose ATK and DEF equal to the single roll multiplied by 100 until the end of the current turn. Compute the current group once; a later summon gets no modifier. No target or cost. A negated activation does not roll. The stat change can resolve during the Damage Step before damage calculation.

card.name: Jarro de Dados
card.summary: VIRE: ambos rolam um dado. Empates repetem os dois dados. Quem perder recebe o maior resultado × 500 de dano; se o maior for 6, recebe 6000.

textEvidence.text: Mandatory Flip effect, no cost or target. Both players roll a six-sided die. Roll both again on ties until results differ. The lower roller takes effect damage equal to 500 times the higher roll, except that a winning six deals 6000 damage. Check victory immediately. Negation consumes no random draws.

card.name: Jogador de Areia
card.summary: Uma vez por turno, na Fase Principal: lance três moedas. Três caras destroem todos os monstros do oponente; três coroas destroem todos os seus. Resultados mistos não destroem monstros.

textEvidence.text: Once per turn during its controller’s Main Phase this monster can toss three coins. Three heads destroy all opposing monsters, including face-down monsters. Three tails destroy all monsters of its controller, including the source. Mixed outcomes destroy nothing. Non-targeting effect, no cost, pays no random draw if negated.
